model.description: Input LS-DYNA K-file containing the hex box part(s) standing in for C-clips

output.description: Output basename (without .k). Writes <output>.k (pressed clip, original PID kept), <output>_cclip_report.json; include mode adds <output>.dynain; deck mode adds <output>_cclip_deck_<pid>.k per clip free_output adds <output>_free.k (un-pressed as-designed model).

clips.description: Per-clip target rules, processed in order: [{pid: N} | {match_part: "CCLIP_*"}] with optional per-clip overrides (free_height | overtravel, width, thickness, profile{flat_bottom,flat_top,radius,tip_rise}, n_arc, n_flat, n_width, elform, match_mass, axis, material, calibration)

calibration.description: F-δ calibration: {point: {deflection, force}} for a single operating point, or {curve: [[deflection, force], ...], operating_deflection: d}. Optional at top level — every clip must end up with a calibration, so give it here OR per clip in clips[]. Optional sub-keys: tolerance (default 0.05), calibrate (thickness|modulus), t_min, t_max

material.description: Clip material {E, nu, rho, sigy} [MPa, -, t/mm3, MPa]. Default: inherit from the box part's K-file material, else BeCu (E=131000, nu=0.3, rho=8.36e-9, sigy=900)

mode.description: analytic (default): closed-form pressed state + *INITIAL_STRESS_SHELL, no solver needed. deck: additionally emit an LS-DYNA compression deck per clip for solver-based preloading

attach.description: Clip foot attachment: none (leave to contact/user) or cnrb (*CONSTRAINED_NODAL_RIGID_BODY spanning foot nodes + board nodes within attach_tol)

stress_output.description: embed (default): *INITIAL_STRESS_SHELL written before *END in <output>.k. include: separate <output>.dynain + *INCLUDE

element.description: Clip element type. shell (default): thin QUAD4 strip, exact through-thickness bending prestress (best for thin spring contacts). solid: HEX8 layers through thickness (n_thick, default 2) — matches an all-solid assembly, no shell contact-thickness offset; for thin clips the shell idealization is more efficient.

axis.description: Compression axis and press-from side. auto = shortest bbox edge, pressed from the + side. Signed forms set the side the mating part presses from (foot on the opposite face): e.g. -z = pressed from below, foot on the top face.

open.description: C opening/bulge direction along the length axis (+ default). '-' mirrors the profile — use it to match the real clip orientation (wipe direction, keep-out).

free_output.description: Also emit the un-pressed (as-designed) model <output>_free.k — same clip geometry at free height, no initial stress. analytic mode only (deck mode's main output is already the free state).

report.description: Write <output>_cclip_report.json (target vs achieved stiffness, calibrated thickness, working force, sig_max/sigy, mass, orphan nodes)

flatten_includes.description: Optional, default false (since 2026-10-17). When the model *INCLUDEs other files, read the whole closure flattened into one standalone deck — each *INCLUDE card replaced by its file's body in LS-DYNA reading order, the include files' *KEYWORD lines dropped — and write the result as one file without *INCLUDE. Without it the op edits only the main deck and stops with exit code 1 (naming this key) when its target parts, materials or cards live only inside an include. Refused when the closure cannot be read completely, has a cycle, or an *INCLUDE + / - or an include *KEYWORD changes the field width.

extra_inputs.description: 옵션이 가리키는 보조 파일의 절대경로. 잡 work/ 폴더로 같이 올라가므로 옵션 값에는 파일 이름만 쓰면 된다. 허용 범위: /data/single/<사용자>/, /shared/uploads/users/<사용자>/, /data/scenario/.

slurm.description: 잡 자원(선택). 생략하면 도구 종류별 기본(전처리 2 CPU·8G, 후처리 4 CPU·16G, 24시간)을 클러스터에서 가장 큰 노드에 맞춰 줄여 쓴다.

dry_run.description: true 면 제출하지 않고 생성될 입력 파일·명령만 돌려준다(PAT 없이도 된다). 먼저 이걸로 확인할 것.

wait_sec.description: 제출 후 이 시간(초) 안에 끝나면 결과(rc·로그 꼬리·작은 산출물)를 함께 돌려준다. 0 = job_id 만.

job_name.description: 잡 이름(결과 폴더 이름이 된다). 생략하면 stmc_<도구이름>.
